instrument: NQ front-month outright; discovery=NQU6 (id 42004177); warm-up=continuous front-month via per-day volume roll

seam_gap.note: Warm-up ends on NQM6; discovery is NQU6. The seam carries both a ~1-month calendar gap and a contract change. Warm-up is therefore used ONLY for relative trailing size percentiles; structural detection is confined to the post-seam discovery series.

timezone_rules.dst: handled via zoneinfo (EDT UTC-4 across discovery; full DST across warm-up)

causality: only bars completed by t used
current event excluded from own trailing history
no future look-back to mark structures earlier
no intrabar ordering inferred from OHLCV
structural detection confined to post-seam discovery series; warm-up used ONLY for relative trailing size percentiles

primitives_params.fvg: 3 consecutive completed candles; body-containment enforced; available after C close; A must be post-seam
primitives_params.ifvg: conversion only on later candle CLOSE beyond opposite boundary (wick/inside insufficient)
primitives_params.rejection_block: wick-only zone; percentiles vs prev 10/20/40 same-tf same-direction wick; invalidation = first body-overlap OR complete wick traversal beyond far boundary
primitives_params.displacement: legs len 1/2/3 both directions; trailing N=10/20/40; raw measurements preserved; NO outcome-based classification threshold
primitives_params.trailing_context: prev-N histories draw from the continuous warm-up series; all prev10/20/40 now fully populated (0 null)

determinism: no randomness; no seeds required; identical inputs reproduce identical outputs
reproduce_cmd: python3 run.py data.csv <discovery.zst> warmup.csv <warmup.zst>  && python3 charts.py
